description: List a product on the SaaSCity launch directory. Creates an inert draft and returns a claim URL; the human opens it to sign in, confirm the listing and pick a launch Monday. Nothing is published or charged until they do, and every listing is reviewed by a person. Free to submit. Free subdomain hosts (github.io, netlify.app...) and domains that already have a listing are refused.
